meta.title: Checked tip: US Senator Slotkin's Poland/Hungary trip, the 'playbook' remark, Sikorski, and the paths back to the map
meta.notes: Tip from a social media post claiming Slotkin 'brought home the playbook' from Poland and Hungary, and that 'Deputy Foreign Minister' Sikorski is celebrating the alleged coup. Sikorski is Foreign Minister (since 13 Dec 2023) and Deputy Prime Minister (since 24 Jul 2025). Slotkin led the US Senate delegation that met Sikorski on 10 Sep 2026 (Defence24). Paths to the map: (1) Slotkin -> Sikorski -> Tusk / Korwin-Piotrowska (public backing); (2) Slotkin -> Applebaum (Carnegie Q&A host, Sikorski's wife) -> NED board 2016-Jan 2025 -> Wawrykiewicz fellowship; Applebaum -> Journal of Democracy editorial board; (3) Slotkin -> Carnegie Endowment (speech venue) -> OSF (top-tier donor) and -> Carothers. All ties are organisational or family; no payment to any judge, Tusk or Wawrykiewicz from Slotkin or her circle was found.

Public statement 31 Oct 2026 (06:18) backing the new TK majority: parliament 'elected, in line with procedure, a new majority of judges'; the outgoing president 'constantly blocked' them; the most senior new-majority judge 'took control of the Tribunal's seat and asked the police for protection'; 'the populist opposition does not want to accept losing control of the Tribunal'; 'the democratically elected government will continue to stand guard over the constitution'. Public support, not a payment or organisational tie.

Slotkin led a US Senate delegation (with Republican senators Thom Tillis and John Curtis) that met Foreign Minister Sikorski in Warsaw on Thu 10 Sep 2026. Topics per MFA: permanent US troop presence, joint arms production, a 2027 US defence bill amendment on industrial cooperation, Ukraine, Poland's G20 role, energy and critical raw materials. No courts, Constitutional Tribunal or rule-of-law item reported. Slotkin and Tillis also visited the defence ministry on 9 Sep.
The Slotkin-led Senate delegation was also received at the Presidential Palace by Przydacz (Nawrocki's foreign-policy chief) on 10 Sep 2026; the delegation met both sides of the Polish executive

held_claims.claim: Slotkin bragged she went to Poland and Hungary and 'brought home the playbook to get out of authoritarian governments'
held_claims.what_was_checked: Full Carnegie speech text, 30 Sep 2026. The 'playbook' line is about Hungary: 'In the past six months, Hungary has quite literally taken the playbook to fight an authoritarian', meaning Orban's defeat at the ballot box. Her X post about the speech does lump both countries ('I visited Poland and Hungary, and I saw firsthand how they have quite literally taken the playbook to fight an authoritarian'). Her only Poland-specific line is 'In Poland, they called this plan the Iron Broom - cleaning the place up', about holding officials who misused public money to account. She does not mention the TK or judges, and the speech came a month before the 30-31 Oct TK events. The words 'brought home the playbook' are the tip's paraphrase, not hers.
